integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically and accompanied by a standalone finite stress-test. Computation is corroborative rather than the basis of the universal claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes every fiber is noncontractible. If a core fiber is a singleton, new cross-fiber beat points can appear and the additive core-cardinality formula can fail. The literature search cannot exclude equivalent statements under different terminology.
title: Fiberwise Stong cores for lexicographic sums of noncontractible finite spaces
